analysis.rationale: Standalone net profit surged 77% YoY and revenue grew 25% YoY, indicating strong operational performance. The results beat prior quarter and year-ago figures, supporting a positive outlook.
analysis.summary: Bajaj Consumer Care reported standalone net profit of ₹7,015.94 lakh for Q1 FY27, up 77% YoY from ₹3,961.12 lakh, with revenue from operations at ₹33,511.25 lakh, up 25% YoY.
